name: uberasm-sensitive-bob-ombs
title: Sensitive Bob-ombs
description:
This UberASM code makes Bob-ombs more sensitive to their environment, as all sentient explosives should be. You can allow Bob-ombs to be detonated by dying (either via sprite contact or lava), by being thrown at a wall, by walking into other sprites, or any combination of the three. Features are enabled via the .asm file.

To be inserted as level code or as GM14 code.
